treatments.monitoring: PHASE 1 (Weeks 1-4): Baseline — clinical pathway adherence using order set compliance tracking. Deliverable: baseline report. PHASE 2 (Months 2-3): Early tracking — clinical pathway adherence measured weekly. Target: 85% pathway adherence. PHASE 3 (Months 4-6): Midpoint review — compare against JCI clinical practice guideline targets. Target: 50% of goal.
